name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (INSPIRE-SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology, Government of India
summary: Science scholarship for eligible students pursuing basic and natural science degrees after Class 12. It is not a Class 11–12 scholarship; confirm eligible courses, selection route and current DST call.
benefits: Award amount, fee coverage and renewal terms vary by programme and academic year. Check the current official provider notification.

eligibility.details: Eligibility depends on the current provider notification, course, institution, academic record and applicable financial or regional criteria. Confirm directly with the official provider.

applicationProcess: Read the current official provider notification and follow its application instructions. ScholarSphere is an information directory and does not collect applications or documents.
statusNote: INSPIRE-SHE supports higher education in eligible science courses. It should not be presented as a general Class 11–12 scholarship or as the same scheme as the discontinued KVPY.
